<function name="Decal" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Performs a trace and paints a decal to the surface hit.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The name of the decal to paint.</arg>
		<arg name="start" type="Vector">The start of the trace.</arg>
		<arg name="end" type="Vector">The end of the trace.</arg>
		<arg name="filter" type="Entity" alttype="table<Entity>" default="NULL">If set, the decal will not be able to be placed on given entity. Can also be a table of entities.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

* BirdPoop
* Blood
* BulletProof
* Cross
* Dark

* Impact.Sand
* Impact.Wood
* Light
* ManhackCut
* Nought

* PaintSplatBlue
